guide.description: history lists every command you've run in this session, numbered in order. It's the shell's memory — useful on its own, and the foundation for reverse-search (Ctrl+R) and the up-arrow, both of which just replay entries from this same list.

examples.note: numbered, in the order you ran them — including this call itself
